history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: the CSV name 'Baba Goudhar Temple' has no web footprint anywhere; 'Gaudeswar near Kesaibahal' suggested by the batch brief is equally undocumented. The best-supported referent is the Gudeswar Shiva Temple (Shree Gudeswar Shiva Gudi) at Durgapali/Durgapalli near Sambalpur - a Shiva temple with a unique linga-shaped superstructure on the bank of the Mahanadi, about 7 km from Sambalpur town and ~2 km from the Maa Samleswari temple. Local legend says a cowherd discovered the Shiva linga; a separate Hanuman shrine stands within the campus, and Mahashivratri is the main festival. CSV corrections needed: town/district is Sambalpur (Durgapalli), NOT Bargarh, and the name is Gudeswar, not Goudhar - treat this mapping as provisional. One source claims 700+ years of history, but this is unverified.
